title: A comment on Reader's sentinel records the Read::chain trap
body: `scan` and `index::Reader` seed a newline before byte 0 so a file opening with a delimiter needs no special case. The sentinel is per stream. `Read::chain` of two files therefore loses the first record of the second when the first file has no trailing newline. No comment or test says so. The `buf` field of `Reader` is the place for the comment. The memory `sentinel-newline-is-per-stream` holds the fact until then and goes once this lands.
close_reason: Landed in 1e8edb4 on dev, as a note on Reader's buf field.
